Main.AnnounceOnLan: Show this Mac on the local network
Main.AnnounceOnLanTip: Lets NexaDesk on the same local network list this Mac for a direct connection. Connecting still needs a one-time code or pairing.
Main.MenuBarNote: Closing this window leaves NexaDesk running in the menu bar: remote control, connection prompts and the banner at the top keep working. Choose Quit from the menu bar to stop it.
Main.AdvancedHelp: You can connect without a server: directly on the same local network, and across networks with Tailscale on both devices, which does hole punching and falls back to a relay when that fails. You need a self-hosted signaling server only if you cannot use Tailscale and want to connect by 9-digit device ID (see docs/DEPLOY.md to deploy one).
Main.ServerHint: Use the form wss://server[:port], for example wss://signal.example.com
Main.ServerNotUsed: Not used (Tailscale is recommended across networks)
LoginItem.Enabled: Opens NexaDesk when you log in to macOS (you still turn on remote control yourself)
LoginItem.RequiresApproval: Allow NexaDesk in System Settings → General → Login Items
LoginItem.NotFound: Only an installed NexaDesk.app can open at login
LoginItem.Off: Off: does not open at login
LoginItem.CannotEnable: Could not turn on opening at login: {0}
LoginItem.CannotDisable: Could not turn off opening at login: {0}
Agent.NoAnswer: The host service did not respond
Agent.Timeout: Timed out connecting to the host service
Agent.Closed: The host service closed the connection
Platform.AgentMissing: Could not find nexa-agent. Use the packaged NexaDesk.app.
Keymap.CannotRead: Could not read the keyboard rules: {0}
